Method of Attack: Injecting text from news articles (e.g., President Trump's impeachment) into malware to bypass antivirus scanning engines by appending known 'goodware' strings to binaries
Using crypters to encrypt or obfuscate malware code to make it Fully UnDetectable (FUD) by antivirus software
Using current events in malware proliferation (e.g., Emotet spam campaign pretending to be information about the Coronavirus)
Impacted Systems: Systems protected by antivirus software that rely on static machine learning engines
Indicators of Compromise: Sample 1 detected by 11/70 security products on VirusTotal
Sample 2 detected by 6/70 security products on VirusTotal
Text from Independent.co.uk impeachment article embedded in executable file information
Text from CNN article about Trump's impeachment added as custom exif data tags
